documentation.value: --------------------------------------------------------------------------- MapDiagnosis: DNPM diagnoses entry → FHIR Condition Profile: MII_PR_MTB_Diagnose_Primaertumor (Parent: MII_PR_Onko_Diagnose_Primaertumor → Parent: MII_PR_Diagnose) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Required clinical status – set to active as DNPM provides no alternative
Required verification status – set to confirmed

--- Guideline treatment status (as extension on Condition) --------------- Note: MII_EX_MTB_Leitlinienbehandlung_Status has context ClinicalImpression; a Condition-level extension is added here to preserve the DNPM value until a dedicated Condition extension is defined. Receivers may prefer to read this value from the associated Behandlungsepisode (ClinicalImpression).
code: required SNOMED slice (423740007) + optional LOINC slice (89262-0)

valueCodeableConcept: DNPM ECOG code/system → obds slice The DNPM system is 'dnpm-dip/patient/ecog-performance-status'; a concept map (dnpm-ecog-to-mii.fsh) provides formal equivalence to https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-onko/CodeSystem/mii-cs-onko-allgemeiner-leistungszustand-ecog but both numeric codes (0–4) are identical, so direct pass-through is used.
